observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 210.» (L18) in the right margin.
body L10: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) read «139,10, emendandum sicut p. 321 docui.»; the line is kept as printed.
body L10: a short horizontal stroke (4.9 pt) stands in the right margin beside the line, at the height of the tops of the letters; it is not a sign.
body L21: «celestis» is printed without the a that the word has in the title of L23; kept as printed.
body L21, L24: «bayḍah» is printed with a dot under the d; in L21 it is italic, in the title L24 bold and letter-spaced.
body L23-L24: the title of the section, from «Constructio» to «appellatur.», is set in bold; the rest of L24 is roman.
body L25: a short slanting stroke stands after «expolitae» below the line, lower than a comma; it is not a comma.
notes_left L1-L6, notes_right L1-L4: the end of note 5 of p. 138.
notes_right L6: «l. l.» is loco laudato, the place cited in note 1.
body L7, L12, L25: specks stand under the line before the t of «temporis» (L7), over the u of «instrumentis» (L12) and under the t of «magnitudinis» (L25); they are not signs.
body L17: a short slanting stroke stands over the u of «tunc», like an acute accent; Latin has no accent here, and it is not read as one. The p of «cupido» is printed broken.
body L23: a speck stands over the u of «Constructio»; it is not an accent.
body L38, L40: specks stand between «versus» and «consistit» and before «duorum», at the height of a hyphen; they are not signs.
notes_left L1-L6: the first words of the lines are printed heavier than the rest («scriptionem», «capitis», «« compositione», «Mediolanensis»); they are not bold.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
